testcase.name: Scenario: Join panels in one dock region as selectable tabs: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/docking-system/docking-system.feature:94:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Join panels in one dock region as selectable tabs ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And two dockable panels are open in separate workspace regions ✔ When the user drags one panel onto the center of the other panel's dock region ✔ Then the destination region indicates a tab insertion target ✔ When the user releases the panel over that target ✔ Then both panels occupy the same dock region as tabs ✔ And one panel is active while the other remains available ✔ When the user selects the other panel tab ✔ Then its contents replace the active panel contents in that region ✔ And the viewport and active document remain available
